query:
SELECT id, name, cas_number, formula, family, chemical_class, smiles, notes, status,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.molecule_id = m.id) as plant_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule_synergies ms WHERE ms.molecule_id_1 = m.id OR ms.molecule_id_2 = m.id) as synergy_links
FROM molecules m
WHERE id IN (1710025, 1720014, 1710027, 1720012)
ORDER BY id;
